messages:
nina-recruiter: Heads-up: saw a few candidate packets with empty attachments after last night's ATS import. Noticed while prepping interview packs. :confused:

ben-ops: Thanks. Job id 824. How many affected?

nina-recruiter: Around 12 candidates, attachments show 0 bytes in the UI but staging objects look normal.

ci-bot: import job 824 completed with warnings. 12 attachments returned E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED. See runbook: https://docs/internal/ats/runbooks#E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED

sam-eng: Pulling post-process logs now. Quick triage: are the zero-byte objects appearing after the internal proxy move?

nina-recruiter: Yes, only after the ATS move. Staging objects intact.

sam-eng: I see repeated upstream timeouts in the proxy around 02:14:37Z, connection closed mid-stream. Our post-process currently marks success without checksum. That's the bug.

ben-ops: Immediate plan: 1) ops rehydrate from staging and validate checksums (I'll run a dry-run first). 2) eng to patch post-process to verify checksum before marking stored.

tara-peopleops: Please flag candidates with interviews tomorrow so we can notify hiring teams.

ben-ops: Dry-run done, listing affected candidates. Running rehydrate now. Will report back when complete.

ben-ops: Rehydrate finished. 12 attachments restored and checksums match. Job exit=0.

sam-eng: Patch merged to add checksum verify + retry on proxy abort. Rolling to canary.

tara-peopleops: Thanks everyone. I'll send a short note to recruiters with the recovered list and next steps.
